common.appTagline: ATS-ready resumes for Ethiopian job seekers

home.title: Buildora – Get your resume past the ATS
home.description: Buildora tailors your resume to any job post with the right ATS keywords. Free keyword check, AI rewrite, PDF and Word downloads. Pay with Telebirr.

builder.title: Build your ATS-friendly resume | Buildora
builder.description: Paste your resume and a job description to get an ATS match score, the missing keywords and an improved resume in seconds. Free to try.

seo.offerFree: Free keyword check and ATS score

hero.title: Get your resume past the ATS and in front of a recruiter
hero.description: Upload your resume, paste the job description, and we'll tailor it with the right keywords. See your improvement score instantly.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps. No design skills needed.

step1.title: Add your resume
step1.description: Upload a file or paste the text of your current resume.

step2.description: Copy the job post you want to apply for and paste it in.

step3.description: We match keywords, show your score, and give you a cleaner version.
